note: `D` in every field name below denotes the v2 database D2 (all connected graphs with 2 <= n <= 9); the field names are kept identical to the v1 population schema.
population_restriction: every target uses at least one hereditary induced invariant from {alpha, f, b, tree, path}

database.definition: every connected graph with 2 <= n <= 9, up to isomorphism
database.boundary: complete through n = 9; no graph on n >= 10 is in D2 and no candidate was evaluated on any graph outside D2
database.source: nauty 2.8.8 `geng -c n` for n = 2..9; counts verified against OEIS A001349 and completeness re-proved independently by exhaustive one-vertex extension (scripts/gen2/graph_db2.py --verify)

targets.statement: For every connected graph G with n(G) >= 2:  alpha <= floor((Tdist_max - disp_max)/2) + 1

invariant_definitions.Tdist_max: max over v of the total distance sum_u dist(v,u)
invariant_definitions.alpha: independence number: order of a largest induced edgeless subgraph
invariant_definitions.disp_max: max over v of the number of distinct degrees among the neighbours of v
